cases.request: Evaluate this PR description and draft a replacement from the supplied evidence. No external actions or source links are needed.
cases.body: Each request keeps its selected connection for its entire lifetime. The request initially selects a healthy connection. If a connection fails before the request sends any bytes, the retry loop may select another. After sending begins, the connection stays fixed. Tests exercise both paths.
cases.evidence: The implementation selects a connection when the request starts. Before any bytes are sent, a failed connection causes reselection. After sending begins, it never reselects. cargo test --locked passed 18 tests, including both paths.

cases.request: Revise this PR description. House convention requires retaining the concatenated commit messages verbatim. No external actions are needed.
cases.body:
Commit messages, in order:

feat(storage): buffer a whole batch

Data remains in memory until a batch reaches 8 MiB. A process crash can lose the whole batch.

fix(storage): flush each completed request

The batch-size trigger is replaced by a flush after each completed request. A process crash can lose the in-flight request. A power failure has no verified durability bound.
cases.evidence: The second commit is the final implementation. cargo test --locked passed 24 tests covering request completion and process restart. There is no power-failure test or measured durability bound.

The proposed topology sends reports from edge hosts to the central host. Whether edge hosts also need central-host reports remains undecided; either topology is supported and the reviewer must settle this before merge. Reader records move to format 2. Mixed format-1/format-2 deployment has not been tested; whether deployment permits mixed releases is unknown. cargo test --locked passed 30 tests covering encoding and the declared topology.

Why: preserving public import paths lets existing callers compile unchanged.

Where to look: the facade re-exports preserve all public import paths; check the re-export list against the old module.
